description: Defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Class' which extends 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Nmtokens' to handle special behavior for HTML class attributes, particularly for splitting and filtering class tokens according to different HTML doctype versions.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Class
classes.description: Handles special parsing and filtering of HTML class attribute tokens based on HTML doctype version.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string of class names into an array, with special handling based on the doctype version.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters class tokens based on allowed and forbidden classes configured, ensuring only valid class names are retained.
